observed_failure: One 36-page PDF exposes many text objects, but embedded-font decoding turns visible English into strings such as '2YHQ 3UREH', making BM25 lexical matching ineffective.
policy_scope: For an R1 local-visual question, this signal marks native text as unusable for page discovery and permits deterministic OCR text recovery before page retrieval.
next_test: Apply the frozen detector to the tune R1 population, generate OCR only for the flagged document, and measure whether its two observed R1 page-discovery failures are recovered.
